eyebrow.zh: 预算 · 刹车 · 让路

headline.zh:
你的 AI 账单
终于有了刹车
headline.en:
Your AI bill
finally has a brake

sub.zh: CFO 把全公司的 AI 账单交给你？按团队、按人设硬上限：快到顶自动减速、超额直接拒掉、重要的人优先跑。给平台 / DevEx 团队的真预算控制器——不止给你看账单，真的把花销管住。
sub.en: When the CFO hands you the whole company's AI bill, set hard ceilings per team and per dev: it auto-slows near the line, refuses past it, and lets the important people go first. A real budget controller for platform / DevEx teams — not just a bill to read, an actual brake on the spend.

title.en: A brake, not just a bill

body.zh: 别的工具月底才送来一张账单——钱已经花完了。tokenctl 在每个请求发出去之前就按预算卡住：快到上限自动排队减速，超过直接拒掉，预算花不出去。
body.en: Other tools hand you a bill at month's end — after the money's already gone. tokenctl checks every request against the budget before it leaves: queues and slows near the ceiling, refuses past it. The budget can't be blown.

body.zh: 不是先到先得的死配额。当关键团队预算吃紧，tokenctl 会主动让掉手头不重要的在飞请求，把额度腾给更要紧的流量——关键发版不会被摸鱼请求拖死。
body.en: Not a static first-come quota. When a critical team runs short, tokenctl yields the unimportant in-flight requests and hands the slack to the urgent traffic — so a critical rollout isn't starved by a trivial one.

title.zh: 所有 AI 模型，一个钱包
title.en: All your AI models, one wallet

body.zh: 不用在每个后台分别设上限、分别看账单。tokenctl 把公司用的所有 AI 流量汇成一份预算——一个总数管住所有模型，谁超谁让。
body.en: No need to set separate ceilings in every console or juggle separate bills. tokenctl rolls all your company's AI traffic into one budget — one number governs every model, and whoever goes over yields.

title.en: A platform team can actually install it

body.zh: 不用搭数据库、消息队列，也不用起第二个进程。一份配置写好你的预算结构，把现有 agent 入口指过来就开始执行——平台团队一下午就能上线。
body.en: No database, message queue, or second process to stand up. One config file describes your budget structure; point your existing agents at it and enforcement starts — a platform team can ship it in an afternoon.

headline.zh: 把公司的 AI 账单管起来
headline.en: Take control of the company AI bill

sub.zh: Apache-2.0 开源；一份配置写好预算结构，把现有 agent 入口指过来就开始执行。
sub.en: Apache-2.0 licensed; one config file describes the budget, point your existing agents at it and enforcement begins.
